steps.content: You lead everyone to escape along a narrow path, and finally come to a relatively safe place.
The refugees behind you shudder and grab onto your clothes. They're all weak and wounded. An old woman tries to protect them with trembling arms.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: ...Save us... Please save us...
Her trembling hands make you anxious. Finally, you calm down, turn around to take her hands, and tell her:

steps.speaker: Choice
options: It's okay now. Rustfire will protect you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: These combatants will lead you to safety. Syndicate will be a safer place when this is all over.

steps.speaker: Rustfire Combatant
steps.content: ...Then what about yourself?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I am going to do things in my way.

steps.content: The long-awaited call rings.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Chief, we're seeing progress on our side. Your plan succeeded. But please also be prepared for the Executive Committee to be furious.
You take off the Rustfire cloak on you and put it on the old lady. You then fetch your MBCC jacket from your bag, and put your usual attire back on.
But at that moment, rustling sounds come from Raven's poetry book.

When you take out the poetry book, it opens by itself and flips to the last page with words— "Its stiff body is curled up in the soil, leaving you in complete loneliness." These are still the weird stanzas she usually writes.
But the next second, the letters begin to move. The ink swims like a snake, forming words that are clear and no longer dark.

steps.speaker: Poetry Collection
steps.content: Found it...

3:21 a.m., March 22, N.F. 113
Eastside - Nirvana Headquarters
A man in a suit sits at the end of a long table without saying a word. People on either side of the table are anxiously questioning each other.

steps.speaker: ID-07
steps.content: What's going on in West District? Why hasn't the company branch been set up yet? We need BR-004 to expand Hypercube production. We have to get West District stable and under control again.

steps.speaker: ID-04
steps.content: The gangs are easy to deal with. The Legion and Burns' forces are also in shambles. The Outland Affairs Bureau has its eyes on Quinn, and its President is now on the MBCC's watchlist. They wouldn't make any major moves right now.

steps.speaker: Man In Suit
steps.content: What obstacles do you still have?

steps.speaker: Man In Suit
steps.content: ...Is it those workers? You still haven't finished off the stragglers from eight years ago?

steps.speaker: ID-03
steps.content: It's a problem left over from history. If I had been around back then, I would have totally eradicated them.

steps.speaker: ID-07
steps.content: Then what has the Executive Committee been doing these days?! It's been half a year already. You still haven't been able to get rid of a bunch of rogue rebels with no money or proper weapons?

steps.speaker: ID-03
steps.content: O-originally, we were going to settle everything these few days. But just now, we were ordered to prioritize locating the whereabouts of a Mania monster...

steps.speaker: ID-03
steps.content: Moreover, there have been some issues with public opinion lately, so we're under a lot of pressure... If the Syndicans don't cooperate, who will do the work...

steps.speaker: ID-04
steps.content: That's your job to figure out. All 7 members of the Executive Committee have received ample funding from Nirvana... including you. We have it all on record...

steps.speaker: ID-03
steps.content: B-but, it's an order from the Speaker of the City Council. The 9th Agency submitted materials to him, so...

steps.speaker: Man In Suit
steps.content: ...What about the councilors?!
Everyone falls silent.

steps.speaker: Man In Suit
steps.content: The economic foundation of DisCity rests in Nirvana's hands. We control the Hypercubes. We should be able to get concessions from everyone, yet you're stonewalling me on all fronts.

steps.speaker: Man In Suit
steps.content: We're already overspending on dealing with hooligans trying to sabotage Nirvana, and now we're wasting money on an irrelevant monster?
All communications suddenly shut down, replaced by a blinking cursor. He knows immediately that he's about to get grilled by that troublesome existence again.

<color=#fb9259>X: </color>Hello.

<color=#fb9259>X: </color>Is the situation out of control again?

<color=#fb9259>Nirvana Director:</color> ...I didn't report it to the higher-ups. No need for you to come.

<color=#fb9259>X: </color>Good. I'll be leaving soon.

<color=#fb9259>X: </color>It's just that the underground shepherd has come to the surface. Right in West District. It must be happy to see such large-scale and long-lasting chaos there.
<color=#fb9259>X:</color> Is that something you forgot to report, or something you didn't discover?

<color=#fb9259>Nirvana Director:</color> Ah... about that... I don't know, I'm not, I have nothing to do with them. Tell the 9th Agency, I didn't...

<color=#fb9259>Nirvana Director:</color> I just want to protect Hypercubes, which are crucial to DisCity. I'm not on their side!
The Nirvana Director stammers nervously, trying hard to distance himself. The cursor flickers quietly for a while, then continues to send responses.

<color=#fb9259>X:</color> It's okay, I know you're not. You're just trying to pursue your own goals, and made a little mistake that anyone could've made along the way. It's fine.

<color=#fb9259>X:</color> My job is to make up for your mistake. Just like eight years ago.

<color=#fb9259>X:</color> All right. Sort out your demands, then help me out and give me some info.

<color=#fb9259>X:</color> After that, leave the rest to me.

steps.speaker: Man In Suit
steps.content: These are...
An ominous premonition runs through Julien's mind. His body shudders as deep feelings of hatred and fear rise to the surface.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: Woke up from the pain again?

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: No... I'm fine.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: How's the situation?

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: There's a lot less pressure on the Drifter Camp. Raven's propaganda worked. Many newcomers joined Rustfire. They also couldn't bear it anymore.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: The Executive Committee also withdrew more than half of their armed forces. I guess ${PlayerName}'s plan really worked. We have some time to catch our breath.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: What about ${PlayerName}?

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: Raven said he's leading the formal troops to find the Corpseborne. It's been confirmed to be hiding in a secret branch of the Executive Committee.
steps.female_content: Raven said she's leading the formal troops to find the Corpseborne. It's been confirmed to be hiding in a secret branch of the Executive Committee.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Is that so...
Julien buries his head in his hands, tormented by both physical pain and anxiety.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: Are you worried the Executive Committee will attack him?
steps.female_content: Are you worried the Executive Committee will attack her?

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: ...I don't think they will. Raven also said they wouldn't be able to deal with the consequences.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: But this is really reminding me of the past.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: If you're really this worried, let me go take a look.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: I've dealt with the Executive Committee many times, and I've also fought that monster before. Tracking, protection, rescue—you name it. I can do'em all.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: Since you say he's hope, I'll make sure no one snatches him away.
steps.female_content: Since you say she's hope, I'll make sure no one snatches her away.
